actualHttp.storage: Disposable temporary SQLite database with synthetic paired devices
actualHttp.runtime: Deterministic owned stdio Codex fixture; no provider requests or user work
actualHttp.dispatcher: The test process accelerates only the reporting dispatcher from 60 seconds to 20 milliseconds. Configured reporting intervals and production scheduling timestamps remain unchanged.
verified: Reports disabled for every unconfigured device
Owner-only explicit device activation; invalid device rejected
Actual scheduled dispatcher creates a completed assistant-only coordinator history turn
Only the configured device receives the versioned coordinatorReport WebSocket envelope
No ordinary notification WebSocket event for reports
Legacy generic notification polling excludes report rows
Report notification direct fetch permits configured device and rejects other paired devices
Report generation and send do not mark material seen
Revoked devices are disabled by the next scheduler tick
actualHttp.cleanup: Owned backend process group and fixture sockets stopped; temporary files/database removed

behavior.cost: The report scheduler performs zero model inference and starts no new agent workers. It uses public observed material and metadata-only status reads. This is not a claim that separately requested native speech is free.
behavior.inventory: Fresh metadata thread/list includes interactive roots and subAgent sources. Hidden owned controllers and archived work are excluded. Bounded or unavailable inventory is explicitly identified as partial/unverified with continuation information.
behavior.material: Reports unseen material progress, final results, failures/blockers and pending questions. Previously offered identities are tracked separately from read/presented state to avoid repeated check-ins.
behavior.coverage: Truncated excerpts are not staged as fully presented catch-up items. Exact full excerpts are acknowledged only after actual coordinator delivery/read acknowledgment; report creation and notification send do not acknowledge them.
behavior.staleWork: Quiet assigned or known active work receives bounded metadata-only status verification. Working, idle or unverified states are reported as observed. Quiet alone is not treated as failure. No automatic steer, resume, turn/start or duplicate worker activation occurs.
behavior.referents: Recent reports are supplied as explicitly identified report-origin context; periodic reports do not overwrite user-command references.
behavior.transport: Notification kind coordinator_report, targeted versioned WebSocket coordinatorReport transport, and assistant-only coordinator history. Generic polling excludes these rows; explicit report fetch is device scoped.
behavior.revocation: Only existing paired devices may be enabled. Tick, publication and post-read persistence recheck validity; revoked preferences and pending publication runs are disabled/cancelled.

limitations: No physical phone verification or production activation was performed by this qualification.
Six metadata pages cover at most 600 newly listed sessions per due tick. A remaining cursor or fetch failure is surfaced; no exhaustive inventory claim is made.
Managed child work is observed when listed/discovered; direct control remains subject to stock runtime restrictions.
Status checks are metadata observations, not progress requests; manual follow-up remains a user decision.
Native speech requested separately may consume account audio usage. Reports do not automatically synthesize speech.
